ambient_events: The treadle lathe ticks over, and a curl of bright brass drops into the tray.
A field-stripped carbine lies on a cloth, its parts laid out in the order they came off.
A wall of small labelled drawers runs the length of the room: SPRINGS, SEARS, LENSES, GLASS.
description: Halloran's real workshop, and the room the shop upstairs is a polite lie about. Vices, gravers, a lathe run off a foot treadle, and racks of the only gear the Watch trust: iron sights, film cameras, wind-up timers, paper maps, a rifle scope with no electronics in it at all. Everything on these racks can be fixed by the person carrying it, in the dark, with cold hands. That is the entire specification.
name: The Bench
